column1: # F 2026-11-23: first-person ride on the tower carousel (a 'yes it would be good' reel; ref instagram.com/reel/Df7_ldBM0xe: a phone in a chair, night, looking out and down past the next chair, the Palace red, the market below). F's notes on the a-c stills: look FORWARD along the swing (riders and chairs ahead), legs in frame, more people spread round the plaza, a bit more glow.
# --pov-swing=T0,LOOK,PITCH,FOV: T0 0 = chairs up and turning (a full turn in ~6 s), LOOK degrees from along-the-swing to outwards. cam/yaw/... are placeholders (the pov camera replaces them). name
